title: Neural Prior Estimation: Learning Class Priors from Latent Representations
abstract: arXiv:2602.17853v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Logit adjustment corrects class imbalance using the empirical class prior. We study whether a comparable class-frequency signal can instead be learned from the network representation, without explicitly supplying class counts to the correction rule. We introduce the Neural Prior Estimator (NPE), which attaches one or more lightweight Prior Estimation Modules (PEMs) to the latent representation. Each PEM is trained with a one-way logistic objective on the ground-truth coordinate. The resulting frequency-dependent outputs are combined into an NPE estimate and used as a learned logit correction, forming NPE-LA. In a simplified scalar model, the optimum of the PEM objective is monotone in the class count and grows asymptotically as $\log N_c$, up to a slower $\log \log N_c$ term. Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 show that NPE-LA is competitive with standard logit adjustment and improves minority-class performance over CE

translated_title: 神经先验估计：从潜在表示中学习类别先验
translated_abstract: 对数几率调整利用经验类别先验来纠正类别不平衡。我们研究是否可以从网络表示中学习到类似的类别频率信号，而无需显式地向校正规则提供类别计数。我们引入了神经先验估计器（NPE），它将一个或多个轻量级先验估计模块（PEMs）附加到潜在表示上。每个PEM在真实坐标上使用单向逻辑目标进行训练。由此产生的频率相关输出被组合成一个NPE估计，并用作学习到的对数几率校正，形成NPE-LA。在一个简化的标量模型中，PEM目标的最优解在类别数量上是单调的，并且渐近地增长为$\log N_c$，直到一个较慢的$\log \log N_c$项。在长尾CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验表明，NPE-LA与标准对数几率调整具有竞争力，并且相比交叉熵（CE）改善了少数类别的性能。
tldr: 本文提出神经先验估计器（NPE），从网络潜在表示中学习类别频率信号，无需显式类别计数，实现了与标准对数几率调整相当的性能，并提升了少数类别的分类效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Neural Prior Estimator (NPE) that learns class frequency signals from latent representations without explicit class counts, achieving competitive performance with standard logit adjustment and improving minority-class performance.
